questions.question: What are the four key parts of Machine Learning?
options: Model, Data, Training, and Trained Model
questions.correctAnswer: Model, Data, Training, and Trained Model

questions.question: What is the purpose of "training" in machine learning?
options: Designing how the user will interact

questions.question: What is a "trained model" in machine learning?
options: A diagram of how the machine was built
The process where the machine is trained on data
A visual representation of the training steps
The final part that makes predictions
questions.correctAnswer: The final part that makes predictions

questions.question: Why might an AI classifier give the wrong prediction?
options: It analyzed a limited amount of data
It wasn't connected to the internet
It processed the input too quickly
questions.correctAnswer: It analyzed a limited amount of data
